task.title: Buy an Organization Subscription
task.shortdesc: Learn how to move from a trial subscription to a paid subscription.

context.p: Use this procedure when your organization has an active or expired trial subscription and you want to purchase a paid plan.

step.cmd: Click Buy subscription in the Subscription Status section.
You are redirected to the Verifone payment system.
Return to the subscription page and confirm that the status changed to Active.
